title: Gerstner wave water material with CPU buoyancy
purpose: Animate a three.js water plane with up to four Gerstner waves, per-pixel analytic normals, deep and shallow colour by facing, sky reflection, sun glint and foam where the surface compresses, plus CPU mirrors of the waves, normal, compression and surface height for floating objects. Use it for seas, lakes and boats.

engine.name: webgl2_browser
engine.notes: three.js r155 or later passed in as THREE under WebGL 2 (array parameters in GLSL and the colorspace_fragment chunk); only 0.186.1 was run.

contract.language: ECMAScript 2020 module; GLSL ES 3.00 through three.js ShaderMaterial

exports.name: createGerstnerWaterMaterial
exports.summary: Water for a horizontal plane mesh; advance uniforms.uTime every frame; an unknown option throws TypeError.

exports.name: packGerstnerWaves
exports.summary: Validates up to four waves and packs them for the uniforms; refuses a steepness sum above 1.

exports.name: gerstnerDisplacement
exports.signature: gerstnerDisplacement(waves, x, z, time) -> [dx, dy, dz]
exports.summary: CPU mirror of the GLSL wave sum: the offset of the rest point (x, 0, z).

exports.name: gerstnerNormal
exports.signature: gerstnerNormal(waves, x, z, time) -> [nx, ny, nz]
exports.summary: CPU mirror of the analytic unit normal at the displaced rest point.

exports.name: gerstnerJacobian
exports.summary: CPU mirror of the compression of the surface: 1 when flat, smaller under bunched crests.

exports.name: gerstnerSurfaceHeight
exports.signature: gerstnerSurfaceHeight(waves, x, z, time, iterations = 8) -> {height, rest, residual}
exports.summary: Water height above a world point, by fixed-point search for the rest point that lands there.

exports.name: GERSTNER_WATER_DEFAULTS
exports.summary: Frozen default options, including four default waves.

exports.name: GERSTNER_WATER_VERTEX
exports.summary: Vertex stage: displaces the world position of the plane.

exports.name: GERSTNER_WATER_FRAGMENT
exports.summary: Fragment stage: analytic normal, body colour, reflection, glint and foam.

options.name: waves
options.type: array of 1 to 4 {direction: [x, z], wavelength, steepness, speed}
options.meaning: Wavelength in world units, steepness 0 to 1 (sum at most 1), phase speed in world units per second.

options.name: foamSoftness
options.meaning: Half width of the foam fade.

limits: Stylized water, not a spectral or physically based ocean: four waves tile visibly at a distance, there is no refraction, depth colour, caustics, screen-space reflection or shoreline. Only displacement fine enough to follow the waves looks right, so use a densely subdivided plane, and the plane must be horizontal in world space (waves use world x and z). Foam is a per-pixel compression mask, not simulated foam that lingers. The surface height search converges slowly where crests are steep (its residual is returned). Skinned, morphed and instanced meshes are not supported. Written for three.js r155 or later; only 0.186.1 was run, in headless Chrome on SwiftShader WebGL 2.
technique_references: Gerstner (trochoidal) waves with amplitude steepness / k
Analytic surface tangents and normal of a sum of Gerstner waves
Jacobian determinant of the horizontal displacement as a foam mask
Schlick Fresnel blend toward a sky colour
Fixed-point inversion of the horizontal displacement for buoyancy
